title: Error body
description: Every refusal, from any route, in one shape. A client that does not recognize the code branches on the HTTP status.

code.description: A stable machine-readable code. Branch on the HTTP status for a code you do not recognize.

requestId.description: Quote this when reporting a problem; it is in the server's log line.

details.description: Present when the refusal came from validation: which fields were wrong.
